items.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022
items.q: And anyway so we have a roomful of musicians and you know we have Steve Gadd sitting in, it wasn’t a drum booth but it was like a partition that went around the drums

ctx.x: So they had a click track. All right.

I mean that album, if you could, there are three components that go through that album. One is Chick, one is Steve Gadd, and the other is Gayle Moran, her vocals, all the way through. But in terms of the basic track, not the vocals of course which added so much, but just the instrumentation. There’s a lot going on but basically Chick and Steve are the — it’s almost like a duet album in a sense. If you listen to that relationship it’s just amazing for that. So there was no click track, no.
